comment: Fixture corpus manifest (P0-4, TP-Q3). Every fixture records its source and license. Policy: public domain / CC0 preferred, CC-BY acceptable; NO NonCommercial (NC) and NO ShareAlike (SA). The loader enforces this policy as a test. See LICENSES.md for a human-readable summary and README.md at the repo-root fixtures/ for usage.
